title: Senior Solution Engineer
description:
SailPoint is the leading, AI-driven security platform providing the autonomous governance that best solves the needs for the modern enterprise. SailPoint makes it possible to automate and streamline the identity journey. We marry technical expertise with business acumen to deliver identity security that will drive business forward. 

We are proud of our team and the culture we have built which has led to our employees voting us “best places to work” – 15 years in a row!

**About the Role**

SailPoint is looking for a talented, collaborative, determined, and motivated
**Senior Solution Enginee**
r to join the India team. You will be a team member of SailPoint’s presales organisation working with our sales teams to support direct and indirect sales efforts, as well as work with our partners and customers.  Your thorough understanding of Identity, Governance, User Administration, Access Management and Cyber Security, coupled with your excellent communication skills will enable you to effectively articulate the value of SailPoint solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences.  Expertise in discovering customer requirements, aligning SailPoint solutions to address identity challenges and demonstrating product capabilities is essential to success in this role.

**The Path to Success**

Becoming a successful Solution Engineer at SailPoint can be as simple as achieving 3 key milestones in 3 months – know SailPoint, know the platform, and demo the platform - with some key steps in between.

Within the first month your goals will include:

* Complete Getting started Checklist, including Pre/Post Revenue Onboarding Coursework, attending HR onboarding Sessions, access Identity University, and complete role specific suggested courses.
* Familiarise yourself with the High-level Function Org Chart; a high-level understanding of our main 5 business functions and the teams that compose them.
* Make use of all video collateral to augment onboarding training.
* Learn the SailPoint pitch.
* Meet the team – Digital Sales, your AE’s, Marketing, Channel, Sales Leadership. (Schedule intro meetings with key stakeholders as identified by your manager)
* Meet your buddy and set up Bi-weekly meetings & 1 to 1’s with your manager.
* Listen in and shadow discovery calls, presentations, demos as much as you can
* Familiarise yourself with key administrative tasks and important metrics

Within 3 months at SailPoint you will have:

* Completed all assigned training to become ‘field ready’
* Present SailPoint, platform and demo to your manager
* Continued to have periodic meetings with your buddy
* Have regular scheduled meetings with your partnering Account Executives, Digital Sales, Customer Success and Delivery Services Team.
* Ready to execute as Lead Solution Engineer
* Know the RFx response process, tools and lead your first RFx response

By the end of your first 12 months at SailPoint you will have:

* Completed your platform training and attained product certification
* Build and maintain a value driven, outcome base narrative
* Confidently engage with senior execs and articulate the business values of identity security
* Led the technical aspects of opportunities alongside your partnering Account Executives from discovery, to presentation, to demo, to evaluation and to close
* Contribute to customer success stories, white papers, blogs and social media posts that show our expertise in the Identity Security Market.
* Actively participate in internal meetings, knowledge sharing sessions and enablement
* Mentor and coach new sales and presales team members on SailPoint solution
* Be the Solution Engineering rock star you were born to be

**Requirements:**

* 5+ years professional experience as a pre-sales technical resource in an enterprise software company
* 3+ years working with Identity, Governance and Access Management solutions.
* Excellent written and verbal communications skills.
* A working knowledge of technical infrastructure including application servers, databases, virtualization and directories is required.
* Familiarity with Java, XML, LDAP, SQL is desirable.
* Understanding of Cloud platforms like Azure, Google and AWS is desirable.
* Ensure proposed deals include technical solutions that accurately address customer needs, and appropriately supported by key customer technical decision-makers.
* Lead and engage in technical conversations with customers.
* Work with Product team to improve roadmap based on technical experience with customers.
* Understand and ability to explain Identity Security processes, deployment models & best practices.

**Location:**

* Mumbai, India
* Travel is expected.

SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.  

Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. Contact applicationassistance@sailpoint.com or mail to 11120 Four Points Dr, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78726, to discuss reasonable accommodations.  NOTE: Any unsolicited resumes sent by candidates or agencies to this email will not be considered for current openings at SailPoint.

title: SalesOps - Manager, Functional- Customer
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Customer**
The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Level: Manager or equivalent
  
  
We are seeking a Sales Operations Technologist Manager to lead the design and implementation of scalable Sales Operations solutions across CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, analytics, and AI platforms. This role combines deep Sales Operations domain expertise with solution architecture, systems integration, automation, delivery leadership, and practical application of Agentic AI.
  
  
The successful candidate will help life sciences organizations improve commercial effectiveness across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, diagnostics, and healthcare businesses. The Manager will lead client engagements, shape solution strategies, develop high-performing teams, and contribute to the growth of our Sales Operations and commercial technology capabilities.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
As a Manager, you will lead multidisciplinary teams and work directly with client executives, commercial leaders, business stakeholders, IT organizations, data teams, and technology partners to deliver measurable business outcomes. You will be responsible for shaping solutions from strategy and discovery through design, implementation, adoption, and value realization.
  
  
You will lead and oversee work across the following areas:
  
  

* Translate Sales Operations requirements into scalable solutions supporting territory and account alignment, segmentation and targeting, quota and incentive planning, sales forecasting, pipeline and opportunity management, account planning, field productivity, pricing and quoting, approvals, and commercial performance reporting.
* Define enterprise solution architectures and delivery approaches integrating CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, analytics, workflow, and AI platforms.
* Lead implementations and solution delivery across platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, SAP, and other enterprise applications.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, APIs, data models, workflows, accelerators, and delivery standards that can be deployed across client environments.
* Identify, prioritize, and oversee practical Agentic AI use cases, including sales planning assistants, forecasting and pipeline analysis agents, next-best-action recommendations, account and territory intelligence, automated opportunity and CRM hygiene, quoting and approval support, and sales performance insights.
* Define and oversee human-in-the-loop controls, access controls, auditability, evaluation criteria, monitoring, and escalation paths for AI-enabled solutions.
* Lead discovery workshops, process assessments, design sessions, demonstrations, executive discussions, testing, deployment planning, and adoption activities.
* Build trusted relationships with client executives and key stakeholders, facilitate difficult decisions, manage expectations, and communicate risks, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly.
* Manage delivery quality, scope, schedule, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and financial performance across workstreams or engagements.
* Coach and develop consultants and senior consultants through structured feedback, hands-on leadership, and opportunities to expand their domain and technology expertise.
* Establish solution roadmaps, implementation plans, operating models, adoption strategies, governance approaches, and measurable value cases.
* Support and lead pre-sales activities, including account planning, proposals, statements of work, solution demonstrations, estimates, client presentations, and pursuit strategy.
* Contribute to market eminence, intellectual capital, reusable assets, accelerators, and offerings that strengthen our Sales Operations and commercial technology portfolio.
* Ensure solutions reflect life sciences-specific requirements related to HCP/HCO data, field force structures, regulatory expectations, data privacy, commercial compliance, and data governance.

**The team:**
Step into our
**Sales & Service**
team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end-to-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service!
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 10+ years of consulting or industry experience, including significant experience leading Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, CRM, CPQ, business transformation, or technology implementation initiatives.
* Experience leading end-to-end client engagements or major workstreams, including delivery planning, team leadership, quality management, risk management, and executive communication.
* Strong understanding of Sales Operations processes and performance drivers, including territory and account alignment, segmentation, targeting, quota and incentive planning, forecasting, pipeline management, account planning, pricing, quoting, approvals, and performance reporting.
* Experience implementing or integrating two or more CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, or analytics platforms.
* Experience with APIs, middleware, data integration, workflow automation, enterprise solution architecture, and delivery governance.
* Practical knowledge of Agentic AI, generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, AI orchestration, or related enterprise AI patterns.
* Ability to convert business requirements into solution strategies, functional designs, technical specifications, implementation plans, roadmaps, and value cases.
* Demonstrated ability to lead workshops, influence senior stakeholders, manage ambiguity, resolve issues, and make sound delivery decisions.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience leading, coaching, and developing consulting or technology delivery teams
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, diagnostics, or healthcare commercial operations.
* Knowledge of HCP/HCO master data, customer consent, field force effectiveness, promotional compliance, and commercial data governance.

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Experience with Salesforce, Veeva CRM, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle CPQ, Salesforce Revenue Cloud, SAP CPQ, or similar platforms.
* Experience with cloud platforms, data warehouses, business intelligence tools, and low-code/no-code automation platforms.
* Familiarity with AI governance, model evaluation, prompt engineering, agent monitoring, responsible AI practices, and enterprise controls.
* Consulting, systems integration, product management, enterprise architecture, or operating model design experience.
* Experience developing proposals, estimates, solution demonstrations, reusable assets, or market-facing points of view.
* Relevant Salesforce, Veeva, CPQ, cloud, data, architecture, or AI certifications.

**Success Measures**
Success in this role will be measured by:
  
  

* Delivery of high-quality Sales Operations solutions that achieve agreed client outcomes, timelines, and quality expectations.
* Adoption, usability, and sustained business value of implemented solutions.
* Reduction in manual processes, disconnected workflows, and operational friction.
* Improved CRM, Sales Operations, and commercial data quality.
* Faster planning, forecasting, quoting, approval, and decision-making cycles.
* Reusability and scalability of solution components across platforms, business units, and clients.
* Demonstrated business value from AI-enabled capabilities with appropriate controls and monitoring.
* Effective management of data privacy, compliance, security, delivery, and operational risks.
* Strong client relationships, team engagement, talent development, and contribution to pursuit and practice growth.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent from accredited university

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Manager - Risk Consulting
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Supply Chain Risk Consulting team at Knowledge Services - Marsh Risk. This role will be based in Gurugram/Pune. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
The Knowledge Services team is an integral part of the future strategy of Global Supply Chain Risk Consulting Practice at Marsh Risk. The supply chain risk consulting team in India comprises supply chain professionals engaged in supporting Marsh colleagues and clients across the globe with understanding, estimating and mitigating structural and operational supply chain risks. We are looking to hire a Manager, Supply Chain Risk Consulting, to support our growth journey.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Drive and execute supply chain risk consulting projects, working closely with risk consultants and senior stakeholders across the regions.
* Develop and present high-impact client deliverables including strategic decks, dashboards, client pitch documents, executive summaries and thought leadership papers.
* Generate actionable insights from complex datasets using tools such as Excel, Power BI, and optionally Python/SQL (preferable).
* Support proposals and pursuits team in timely development and submission of RFPs, support consulting engagements and business development through data analytics, visualization and supplement the insights with additional secondary research.
* Contribute to the development and roll-out of new supply chain value propositions by collaborating with global stakeholders and adding value with individual perspectives/insights.
* Own and manage knowledge repositories to ensure high-quality and relevant content and actively share insights to support project and business development work improving efficiency and decision-making.

**What you need to have:**

* Post Graduate degree in business management with 4-6 years of relevant experience preferably in a supply chain role.
* Strong consulting and proposal building skills demonstrated by prior experience in a top-tier professional services firm
* Proven expertise in using secondary research databases like S&P Cap IQ, Alpha Sense and other market intelligence platforms
* Ability to leverage AI tools to supplement the deliverables and automate standardized tasks
* Advanced analytical skills with an ability to turn data into insights by crafting compelling PowerPoint presentations
* Smart, collaborative, relationship and outcome focused with the ability to make decisions where ambiguity exists
* Ability to demonstrate sound judgment in the prioritization of competing work assignments, escalation of issues and the formulation of solutions

**What makes you stand out?**

* Strong understanding of supply chain processes and risks demonstrated by prior experience in a top-tier professional services firm or industry
* Knowledge of data analytics tools (Power BI, SQL, Python) and data modelling on Excel with a proven expertise in applying analytics to generate supply chain insights

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
Marsh is committed to providing an inclusive work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best, most qualified people and value colleagues of all backgrounds, without regard to age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
  
  
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: B2B Lead Generation Associate – Revenue & Lead Management (FOS)
description:

,
**a protege of Sri Chaitanya in the edtech space**
, is focused on transforming the digital learning landscape for learners and educators. With over 40+ years of experience in the education domain and highly versatile leaders, the organization combines deep academic expertise with a digital-first approach. Infinity Learn aims to impact every learner’s life by understanding individual learning needs and helping turn educational aspirations into reality. The company offers a comprehensive suite of products, including online live classes, SelfLearn recorded modules, online mock tests, and a 24x7 doubt clearance app. Backed by three decades of experience, Infinity Learn strives to enhance learning outcomes for both teachers and students.

:

title: Senior Manager (Software Solutions Architecture)
description:
**About Sibros Technologies**
****Who We Are****
Sibros is accelerating the future of SDV excellence with its Deep Connected Platform™ that orchestrates full vehicle software update management, vehicle analytics, and remote commands in one integrated system. Adaptable to any vehicle architecture, Sibros’ platform meets stringent safety, security, and compliance standards, propelling OEMs to innovate new connected vehicle use cases across fleet management, predictive maintenance, data monetization, and beyond.
  
  
Learn more at www.sibros.tech.
  
  
****Our Mission****
Our mission is to help our customers get the most value out of their connected devices.
  
  
Follow us on
  
  
LinkedIn | Youtube | Instagram
  
  
**About The Role**
****Job Title****
: Senior Manager (Software Solutions Architecture)
  
  
****Location****
: Remote, India
  
  
****Job Type****
: Full-Time
  
  
****Experience****
: 10+ years, including 4+ years managing engineers
  
  
You will travel to prospective and existing OEM customers and design how their systems connect to the Sibros Deep Connected Platform: vehicle-to-cloud connectivity, data pipelines, OTA update programs, and the integration points into their own manufacturing and after-sales systems. You are the person the customer's engineering leadership talks to when they need to know how this will actually work in their environment.
  
  
From design to delivery, your team sits at every step of the customer engagement and owns what comes out of it: the Sibros platform running inside the customer's own cloud account, with Sibros keeping ownership and day-to-day management of the environment, plus the customer-specific solutions that let the platform interface with an OEM's manufacturing and after-sales processes. You design the solutions that bring our product platform and our customers' requirements together. As part of the Infrastructure department, you help keep that platform performing reliably and at scale.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the customer architecture. Act as the primary technical contact for OEM accounts and prospects. Travel on site to run architecture workshops, technical deep dives, and the executive conversations that follow them.
* Design the integration. Architect how a customer's vehicle programs, cloud estate, and enterprise systems connect to the Deep Connected Platform, and make sure the design holds up against their security, compliance, and data residency requirements.
* Support pre-sales. Lead proof-of-concept engagements, architecture reviews, and RFP responses, and carry them through to a design that can be deployed rather than one that only reads well.
* Run the Customer Hosted team. Manage the engineers who deploy and operate the Sibros platform inside customer cloud accounts, where we keep ownership of the service without owning the account it runs in.
* Deliver custom solutions. Direct the design and delivery of customer-specific work built within the platform, using AI-assisted development tooling to keep delivery fast without giving up quality.
* Grow the team. Hire, coach, and set direction, and stay technical enough to be a genuine reference for your engineers rather than only their manager.
* Work across Sibros. Partner with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and Customer Success to turn a customer's business objectives into something we can build and operate.

**Basic Qualifications**
****What You Should Know****

* Experience. 10+ years across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, systems engineering, networking, and security.
* People management. 4+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring and performance responsibility.
* Architecture. 5+ years designing, implementing, or consulting on complex cloud architectures, with production deployments behind you.
* Hands-on infrastructure. Strong Kubernetes and Terraform. You should be able to review your team's work on a customer-hosted deployment and recognise when the answer is wrong.
* Cloud. Working knowledge of at least one major hyperscaler (AWS or GCP), and of deploying into an environment you do not control, under someone else's security and compliance rules.
* Communication. Able to explain the same design to a customer's VP of Engineering and to the engineer who has to build it, and be understood by both.
* Travel. Willing to travel internationally to customer sites on a regular basis.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Connected vehicle, SDV, or automotive telematics background.
* Hands-on experience integrating cloud-native platforms with OEM enterprise backends (PLM, MES, SAP, after-sales).
* Experience running software in a customer-controlled environment, where you own the service but not the account.
* Familiarity with multi-region delivery across regions, and the requirements that differ between them.
* Comfortable using LLM-based tooling in daily engineering work. Experience with Claude Code is a bonus.
* Real-time and batch processing using technologies such as MQTT, Kafka, Kubernetes, time-series databases, and the analytics tooling on top of them, applied to connected vehicles or comparable IoT workloads.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation package with performance incentives.
* A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and the opportunity for rapid career advancement.
* Access to continuous learning and development opportunities.
* Flexible working hours to accommodate different time zones.
* Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance and wellness programs.
* A culture that values innovation and promotes a work-life balance.

****Equal Opportunity Employer****
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: Quality and Regulatory Practice Leader
description:
* Serve as the primary Subject Matter Expert for Quality and Regulatory Affairs across medical device product lines, providing strategic guidance to internal teams and clients.

* Architect end-to-end regulatory solutions for complex client problem statements, translating business needs into actionable regulatory strategies.

* Lead the design and development of winning solutions, proposals, and customer-facing presentations in response to RFPs, RFIs, and strategic business opportunities.

* Define and drive go-to-market (GTM) strategy for quality and regulatory service offerings, identifying new business opportunities and market positioning.

* Partner with sales, pre-sales, and delivery teams to craft differentiated value propositions and win themes for regulatory consulting engagements.

* Advise clients on regulatory submission strategies, including 510(k), PMA, De Novo, EU MDR technical documentation, and emerging requirements under the EU AI Act.

* Monitor and interpret evolving regulatory requirements across FDA (US), EU MDR/IVDR, PMDA (Japan), CDSCO (India), NMPA (China), and other major geographies, translating changes into actionable guidance.

* Support clients through the full product lifecycle – from regulatory classification and strategy through submission, approval, and post-market surveillance.

* Build and mentor internal regulatory capability, establishing best practices, templates, and playbooks for proposal development and client delivery.

* Represent the organization in client discussions, workshops, and industry forums as a thought leader in medical device quality and regulatory affairs.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Quality, Clinical, Engineering, Legal) to ensure proposed solutions are technically sound and compliant.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 15–20 years of progressive experience in Quality and Regulatory Affairs within the medical device industry.

* Proven track record of creating winning solutions, proposals, and customer presentations for regulatory consulting or managed-services engagements.

* Extensive, hands-on experience with global regulatory frameworks, including:

* US FDA – 510(k), PMA, De Novo pathways

* European Union – EU MDR, EU IVDR, and the EU AI Act

* Japan – PMDA requirements and approval processes

* India – CDSCO regulations

* China – NMPA regulations, and other emerging geographies

* Deep expertise in quality management systems (ISO 13485, ISO 14971) and their application to regulatory submissions.

* Demonstrated ability to architect solutions for complex, multi-geography regulatory problem statements.

* Strong experience responding to complex RFPs – including solution design, pricing strategy input, and executive-level storytelling.

* Excellent client-facing communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with experience engaging C-suite and senior stakeholders.

* Strong business acumen with the ability to connect regulatory strategy to commercial outcomes and go-to-market planning.

* Experience mentoring teams and building organizational regulatory capability and thought leadership.

title: Networking Technical Services Systems Integration Specialist
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Networking Technical Services (TS) Systems Integration Specialist is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for providing technical support to clients.
  
  
This role is able to compile technical specifications in a clear, concise, unambiguous manner to explain the advantages and disadvantages of options leading to the final solution and are able to create alternative solutions as backup planning.
  
  
This role works towards professional to expert level certification, whilst at the same time developing business knowledge.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

* Interacts with clients on site and remote to meet complex requirements of a solution.
* Escalates unresolved problems and issues to the relevant third parties.
* Responds to escalated client requests.
* Escalates complex problems to the relevant third parties.
* Writes reports and proposals and completes and maintains project documentation.
* Assists with the documentation of standard operating procedures relating to installations and fixes.
* Acts as coach and mentor to more junior Implementation Engineers and Technicians.
* Assumes responsibility for the coordination of the activities of the junior Engineers, in line with performance targets.
* Included in higher complexity design work, with input to the design expected.
* Expected to take ownership of relevant technologies according to domain or specialization.
* Performs any other related task as required.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Seasoned understanding and appreciation of technical design and business principles.

Capabilities of an M&A I&D Finance & Supply Chain practitioner will include the following:
  
  

* Advising clients on separating/carving out a business unit for divestiture and integrating newly acquired target with buyer’s organization with focus on the Finance and / or Operations (Supply Chain, Procurement and/or Manufacturing) workstreams.

* Analyzing financial statements and large financial and non-financial data sets.

* Masters in Business Administration
* Masters Degree in Actuarial

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Consulting Background
* M&A advisory experience

MBA or Master’s Degree (Actuarial)

Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune

**Required Qualifications**

* 1-2+ years of embedded systems, applications engineering, product systems, processor architecture support, customer solutions, or related semiconductor experience.
* Understanding of MCU/MPU product architectures, embedded software, hardware/software partitioning, and customer product requirements.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of: automotive electronics, industrial automation, robotics/motor control, networking/infrastructure, e-mobility, or Edge AI systems.
* Experience creating technical collateral, competitive analysis, architecture recommendations, or requirements documentation.
* Comfortable working across hardware, software, safety/security, connectivity, ormixed-signal technology domains.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to explain tradeoffs clearly and crisply.

**Preferred Background / Target Talent Pools**

* Systems, applications, field applications, solutions engineering, or product architecture experience at embedded processor, MCU/MPU, industrial, automotive, or networking semiconductor companies.
* Experience with real-time operating systems, embedded Linux, AUTOSAR, motor-control software, industrial protocols, TSN, CAN/CAN-FD/CAN-XL, Ethernet, HSM/security, or functional safety a plus.
* Customer-facing experience with OEMs, Tier-1s, industrial automation companies, robotics/motion-control companies, or networking/infrastructure customers a plus
* Ability to travel for customer workshops and internal engineering reviews as required.

GlobalFoundries is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard.

All offers of employment with GlobalFoundries are conditioned upon the successful completion of background checks, medical screenings as applicable and subject to the respective local laws and regulations.

title: B2B AI Lead Gen Intern
description:
**Company Description**
Indus Connect Realty is an emerging real estate solutions provider focused on connecting businesses with commercial properties that match their operational and growth needs. The company aims to modernize traditional real estate practices by integrating data-driven decision-making and technology-enabled processes. Indus Connect Realty values collaboration, integrity, and long-term client relationships, working closely with partners to deliver transparent and efficient services. As the organization grows, it is investing in digital tools and AI-driven methods to enhance lead generation and business development in key markets such as Pune City.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time hybrid role for a B2B AI Lead Gen Intern based in Pune City, with a mix of on-site work and some work-from-home flexibility. The intern will support the business development team by using AI tools and online platforms to identify, qualify, and segment B2B leads in targeted industries. The intern will collaborate with sales and marketing team members to refine lead criteria, track lead performance, and provide regular reports on lead quality and conversion potential. The role also involves learning and applying best practices in AI-assisted prospecting, CRM usage, and maintaining accurate documentation of all lead generation activities.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong research and data gathering skills, with the ability to analyze company information and identify relevant decision-makers.
* Candidates should possess basic familiarity with AI tools, automation platforms, or lead generation software, and a willingness to quickly learn new digital tools.
* Candidates should possess good written and verbal communication skills for preparing lead lists, outreach drafts, and internal updates.
* Candidates should possess strong organizational and time management skills to handle multiple lead-generation tasks and maintain accurate records.
* Candidates should possess a collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment with cross-functional teams.
* Enrollment in or completion of a degree program in Business, Marketing, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field is preferred.
* Prior exposure to B2B sales, marketing, or internship experience in lead generation or CRM-based work will be considered an advantage.

title: Business Planning & Analysis Manager
description:
*Armacell provides numerous and diverse career opportunities. Add your talent to ours and make a difference around the world!*
The Business Planning & Analysis (BP&A) Manager will play a pivotal role in financial planning, performance analysis, and strategic business decision-making across multiple manufacturing units and entities. This role involves close collaboration with senior leadership, finance, and operational teams to drive financial efficiency and profitability. Additionally, the BP&A Manager will act as a strategic business partner, providing insights and recommendations to enhance operational effectiveness.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Financial Planning & Analysis:**

* Drive the annual budgeting, quarterly & month forecasting, long- range planning process for multiple manufacturing units & entities.
* Conduct variance analysis (actual vs budget/forecast) and deliver insights to improve performance.
* Develop and track key financial and operational KPIs (e.g. Sales Price trend, Cost per UOM, Capacity utilization, Raw Material consumption trend)
* Prepare plant/entity level-level reports and management-level presentation with actionable recommendations.

**Business Partnering & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as a finance business partner to Business & Plant Heads, Operations and Supply Chain team.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve sales price trend, product mix, drive cost optimization, productivity initiatives & capital investment decisions by provide data-driven insights, continuous engagement, suggesting strategies.
* Provide financial insights and analysis for new product introductions, process improvement, and strategic projects including post launch analysis.
* Review business assumptions constructively and facilitate stake holders to make sound decision-making by conducting financial scenario analyses and identifying growth opportunities

**Cost & Profitability Analysis**

* Analyze margin/profitability and cost across different segments & regions.
* Identify cost-saving initiatives, process efficiencies, and areas for margin improvement

**CAPEX & Investment Analysis**

* Evaluate capital expenditure proposal from manufacturing units, marketing & new product development team through ROI, Payback etc.
* Monitor ongoing projects spends ensure alignment with approved Budgets.
* Partner with project teams to ensure value realization post-investment.

**Preferred Skills & Attributes**

* Experience in multi-entity financial planning across diverse manufacturing units.
* Ability to translate financial insights into actionable business strategies.
* Exposure to cost accounting and process automation in manufacturing operations.
* Leadership capabilities with a collaborative approach to cross-functional teamwork.

**Reporting Structure**

* Reports to Head of Finance.
* Works closely with business unit heads, operational teams, and senior executives.

**Key Dimensions**

* Budgeting & Forecasting
* Margin & Pricing Analytics
* Revenue & Channel Analytics
* Cost Control
* Capex & ROI Analysis
* Working Capital Management
* Performance Reporting
* Compliance & Governance

**Job Specifications**
**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Qualified Professional in Finance - CA is MUST
* Strong expertise in financial modelling, data analytics, budgeting, and forecasting.
* Proficiency in ERP systems, Power BI, and advanced Excel tools for data analysis and reporting.
* Excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong communication and presentation abilities with a data-driven mindset.

**Professional Experience (how long)?**

* 3-5 years of experience in financial planning & analysis (FP&A), business partnering, or corporate finance, preferably in a manufacturing environment.

**Time Type**
Full time

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300053
description:
**Description**
**Department/Project Description**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Product Architect to work at the intersection of core product engineering, AI orchestration, and high-impact client deployment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).
  
  
You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands-on builder, deep product architect, and first-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Job Responsibilities**
**Domain-Specific AI Integration**
Architect Intent-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).
  
  
Context-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.
  
  
Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.
  
  
**Product Delivery & SDLC Acceleration**
Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.
  
  
Establish Guardrails & AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human-in-the-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2).
  
  
Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge-case test generation.
  
  
**Forward-Deployed Customer Engagement**
Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.
  
  
Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.
  
  
Executive Value Articulation: Present technical architectures, security postures, and measured business outcomes to both engineering teams and C-level executives (CTO, Chief Risk Officer, CPO).
  
  
Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Must-Have Qualifications And Experience**
Experience: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise product architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture, with at least 5+ years spent delivering high-scale products within the Financial Services or Enterprise SaaS sectors.
  
  
Technical Fluency: Deep, hands-on fluency with the modern AI stack. You must be able to build, evaluate, and debug AI development tools, agentic frameworks, and IDE-based assistants.
  
  
Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of financial technology standards, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, data privacy laws, and enterprise architecture patterns.
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
Direct experience with tools/frameworks like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases.
  
  
Background in customer-facing technical roles such as Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, or Technical Advisor.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**

**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. title: EYP-SCM-Associate Manager

EY-Parthenon’s GDS Supply Chain (SCM) team works closely with our US Supply Chain Practice and onsite counterparts and clients to deliver value through the seamless execution of supply chain levers in both deal and non-deal environments. The team works across pillars of Plan, Source, Make and Deliver in the context of a transaction and as standalone transformation initiatives. This also includes working in global business development initiatives, competency building projects, and building state of the art solutions for our clients.
  
  
**The opportunity**
EY-Parthenon’s GDS SCM practice works on the most complex and high-profile global transactions and supply chain transformations. We are a group of experienced strategy and transaction professionals with a background in supply chain and operations who work across a broad portfolio of clients and industry sectors. As such, we bring a wealth of deep supply chain functional knowledge to our clients in the context of complex transactions and transformations.
  
  
This is an opportunity to work across the entire transaction lifecycle (pre-sign diligence, sign-to-close planning, post-close execution, etc.) of the most complex integrations (M&A) and divestitures. Moreover, you’ll have the opportunity to help our clients solve complex supply chain problems, developing innovative solutions that transform the supply chain, improving performance and resiliency across the plan, source, make, deliver/return functions of the supply chain.
  
  
We’re looking for an Associate Manager, who supports key outcomes and executes complex workstreams in supply chain engagements. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a fast-growing service offering in Strategy and Transactions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Manage small to mid-sized engagements or parts/workstreams of large engagements that help our clients solve some of their most pressing supply chain issues. Support key decision makers in developing and executing their transaction strategy to secure deal value. Lead projects that span one or more supply chain functions (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver) in both deal and non-deal environments. Manage engagements, problem-solve, facilitate, ensure engagement success, and quality in delivery
* Establish regular connectivity and reporting to the US SCM team members. Build relationships with EY offices across the globe. Responsible for high degree of GDS user satisfaction with engagement processes and work products
* Engage on larger SaT projects and pitch for potential supply chain interventions. Ability to analyse the evolving market environment and build solutions / services to cater to the same. Develop Point of View documents and support business development initiatives
* Manage supply chain consultants/analysts. Help the team members develop expertise in supply chain. Mentor team members to deliver on high quality output on engagements
* Provide insights/observations based on industry/functional knowledge and best practices that span Plan, Source, Make, and Deliver. Leverage expertise in transactions, synergy assessments, and deal implementation on transactions related projects

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Business and Commercially Driven - work in a fast-paced, exciting environment with strong business acumen to drive value to our clients
* Capability Development - contribute to our practice development initiatives, supporting the continued focus on our team as a great place to work
* Learning - learn and develop technical and personal skills to support achievement of career goals, through a blend of structured learning, coaching and experiences
* Building Relationships - cultivate strong working relationships with clients and support to key decision makers

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A post Graduate degree in business management from a premier institute with 6-8 years of applicable consulting and industry experience
* At least 2 years of management consulting experience across SCM functional areas (Plan, Source, Make, and Deliver) in a top tier consulting firm
* Experience in running cost transformation program across direct and indirect categories
* An understanding of the transaction life cycle, and carve-out / integration of a business post-announcement of transaction
* Ability to contribute to client discussions with individual perspectives / insights
* Knowledge of data analytics tools (e.g. Alteryx, Python, Power BI, SQL) and expertise in applying analytics to solve supply chain problems/issues
* Excellent problem solving, project management, facilitation and interpersonal skills
* Willingness to undertake international travel as per business requirements
* Strong communication and presentation skills

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience with working on transactions and in buy and integrate, or sell and separate scenarios
* Experience with the implementation of Lean Six Sigma projects, and statistical tools

**What You Can Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 3,500+ professionals
* Opportunities to work with EY SaT practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

Moreover, you’ll have the opportunity to help our clients solve complex supply chain problems, developing innovative solutions that transform the supply chain, improving performance and resiliency across the plan, source, make, deliver/return functions of the supply chain.
  
  
We’re looking for a Manager, who supports key outcomes and executes complex supply chain engagements. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a fast growing service offering in Strategy and Transactions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and oversee engagements that help our clients solve some of their most pressing supply chain issues. Support key decision makers in developing and executing their transaction strategy to secure deal value. Lead projects that span one or more supply chain pillars (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver) in both deal and non-deal environments. Manage engagements, problem-solve, facilitate, ensure engagement success, and quality in delivery
* Build relationships with EY offices across the globe. Responsible for high degree of GDS user satisfaction with engagement processes and work products
* Engage on larger SaT projects and pitch for potential supply chain interventions. Ability to analyse the evolving market environment and build solutions / services to cater to the same. Develop Point of View documents and support business development initiatives
* Manage a team of supply chain consultants. Help the team members develop expertise on all SCM pillars. Mentor junior team members to deliver on high quality output on engagements
* Provide insights/observations based on industry/functional knowledge and best practices that span Plan, Source, Make, and Deliver. Leverage expertise in transactions, synergy assessments, and deal implementation on transactions related projects

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Business and Commercially Driven - work in a fast-paced, exciting environment with strong business acumen to drive value to our clients
* Capability Development - contribute to our practice development initiatives, supporting the continued focus on our team as a great place to work
* Learning - learn and develop technical and personal skills to support achievement of career goals, through a blend of structured learning, coaching and experiences
* Building Relationships - cultivate strong working relationships with clients and support to key decision makers

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Post Graduate degree in business management from a premier institute with 8-12 years of applicable consulting and / or industry experience
* At least 3 years of management consulting experience across at least two SCM pillars (Plan, Source, Make, and Deliver) in a top tier consulting firm
* An understanding of the transaction life cycle, and carve-out / integration of a business post-announcement of transaction
* Experience in running cost transformation program across direct and indirect categories
* An understand of Design to value especially teardown led competitive benchmarking and value engineering tailored for Direct Materials
* Experience leading and managing in complex business environments
* Knowledge of data analytics tools (e.g. Alteryx, Python, Power BI, SQL) and expertise in applying analytics to solve supply chain problems/issues
* Excellent problem solving, project management, facilitation and interpersonal skills
* Willingness to undertake international travel as per business requirements
* Strong communication and presentation skills

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience with the implementation of Lean Six Sigma projects, and statistical tools
* Experience with working on transactions and in buy and integrate, or sell and separate scenarios

**What You Can Look For**

* A team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 3,500+ professionals
* Opportunities to work with EY SaT practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Controls Testing Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**B. Bill of Quantities, Cost Estimation & Proposal Development**
**C. Technical Proposals & Bid Documentation**
**D. Client Engagement & Presales Support**
**E. Internal Collaboration & Presales Standards**
3. AUTHORITIES
  
  

* KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
* System Architecture & Scope Definition
* Develop full IBMS system architecture proposals for mission-critical data center projects during the bid phase, encompassing BMS, FACP, VESDA, Water Leak Detection (WLD), Access Control, CCTV, Rodent Control, and power/environment monitoring subsystems.
* Define BMS controller platform, network topology, and integration architecture — specifying primary, field-level devices, gateways, and communication protocols (BACnet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, OPC-UA).
* Prepare detailed I/O point schedules, controller loading calculations, and scan-time calculations for DDC/PLC systems during the estimation phase.
* Design IBMS network architecture including data network topology, switch selection criteria, BACnet/IP architecture, and integration requirements for third-party systems (DCIM, EPMS, SCADA/HMI).
* Evaluate and recommend open protocol versus proprietary integration strategies, identifying technical risks and mitigations for the proposed architecture.
* Define subsystem integration requirements, API/protocol mapping, and IBMS-to-DCIM interoperability architecture for high-density and AI data center environments.
* Develop control philosophy summaries and sequences of operation (SOO) drafts to support technical sections of bids, clarifying system-level control strategies without committing to detailed execution design.
* Prepare comprehensive Bill of Quantities (BOQ) for IBMS scope across critical and non-critical data center projects, covering all hardware, software, licensing, integration, engineering, and commissioning cost elements.
* Develop itemized cost estimation sheets with material, labor, third-party integration, software licensing, and contingency allowances, using established Vertiv rate cards and vendor quotations.
* Produce Basis of Estimate (BOE) documents clearly defining scope boundaries, assumptions, exclusions, and unit-cost rationale for each IBMS bid.
* Benchmark IBMS costs against historical project data, vendor list prices, and market intelligence to ensure commercial competitiveness without compromising technical quality.
* Identify and quantify scope risks in estimates, recommending provisional sums and risk allowances where appropriate.
* Prepare and maintain IBMS-specific pricing matrices and parametric estimation models to accelerate turnaround for repeat bid types (colocation, hyperscale, enterprise DC).
* Contribute to internal bid review and approval processes — presenting cost models, assumptions, and risks to senior management and business development leads.
* Lead preparation of technical proposal sections for IBMS scope in RFP/RFQ responses, including executive summaries, technical narratives, compliance matrices, and scope clarification letters.
* Develop technical write-ups describing the proposed IBMS architecture, system capabilities, integration approach, and value differentiators — tailored to client technical and commercial requirements.
* Prepare compliance matrices mapping client specifications and standards requirements (IEC 61850, ASHRAE, TIA-942, NFPA 72, EN 54, IS 3043, NBC 2016) against the proposed solution.
* Produce scope-of-work documents and exclusion lists that define clear contractual boundaries for the IBMS scope within the overall project.
* Develop technical clarification logs and pre-bid query registers, managing responses with accuracy and commercial awareness.
* Prepare value engineering proposals and alternative technical solutions where client requirements offer scope for cost optimization without reducing functional integrity.
* Ensure all bid documents are produced in accordance with Vertiv brand and documentation standards, with consistent formatting and professional presentation.
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for IBMS scope during client pre-bid meetings, site surveys, and technical clarification discussions.
* Conduct technical feasibility assessments for proposed IBMS architectures, advising clients and the sales team on achievable scope, realistic timelines, and technical risks.
* Prepare and deliver technical presentations, solution overviews, and IBMS architecture demonstrations to client technical teams and procurement stakeholders.
* Participate in pre-bid site walks, capturing existing infrastructure constraints, network connectivity requirements, and integration opportunities.
* Support post-submission technical discussions, clarifications, and negotiation of technical scope with clients and consultants.
* Build and maintain trusted technical relationships with key clients, consultants, and specifiers in the data center and critical infrastructure markets.
* Provide technical input to sales team's go/no-go assessments, identifying bid qualification criteria and scope risks early in the sales cycle.
* Collaborate with Sales, Solution Architecture, Project Management, and Commercial teams throughout the bid lifecycle, ensuring aligned scope, schedule, and cost assumptions.
* Maintain and continuously improve IBMS presales estimation templates, BOQ master libraries, and technical proposal boilerplate in line with evolving product platforms and market requirements.
* Conduct lessons-learned analysis on won and lost bids to refine estimation accuracy, technical positioning, and proposal quality.
* Support peer review and quality assurance of IBMS proposals prepared by other team members, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with Vertiv standards.
* Provide technical mentoring and knowledge transfer to junior presales engineers and sales staff on IBMS architecture concepts and estimation methodology.
* Interface with the Vertiv product management and engineering teams to stay current on controller platforms, new product introductions, and integration capabilities relevant to presales.

The IBMS System Architecture Expert – Presales & Estimation holds the following delegated authorities within the presales and estimation function:
  
  

* Approve IBMS BOQ, cost estimates, and technical proposals prior to submission to the commercial review board, within authorized value limits.
* Define and confirm IBMS technical scope inclusions and exclusions in bid submissions without requiring individual engineering sign-off for standard scope items.
* Recommend go/no-go decisions on IBMS scope elements and flag technical red-flags to the Bid Manager or Lead Controls Engineer.
* Engage directly with clients, consultants, and specialist vendors during the bid phase for technical clarifications, pre-bid meetings, and scope discussions.
* Request vendor quotations for specialist IBMS equipment, software, and integration services to support estimation.
* Propose value engineering changes and alternative technical solutions during bid development, subject to review by the Lead Controls Engineer.
* Reject internally submitted estimation data or technical content that does not meet Vertiv quality standards or accuracy thresholds.

4. QUALIFICATIONS
**4.1 Education**

* Dip OR bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronics & Communication, Instrumentation, Automation & Control, or a closely related technical discipline.
* Additional certifications in BMS/IBMS platforms are strongly preferred: Distech Controls, Niagara Framework / Tridium JACE, Honeywell, or Schneider Electric EcoStruxure.
* Training or certification in estimation methodology, technical proposal writing, or pre-sales engineering is a positive differentiator.
* Project management training (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) is advantageous for managing complex bid timelines and multi-stakeholder reviews.

**4.2 Experience**

* 5–7 years of progressive experience in IBMS/BMS controls engineering, with a minimum of 4 years in a presales, estimation, or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrated track record of preparing IBMS BOQs, cost estimates, and technical proposals for mission-critical data center projects.
* Hands-on experience with BMS controller platforms — DDC/PLC platforms.
* Proven experience defining IBMS network architectures and communication integration strategies (BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, SNMP, OPC-UA, REST API).
* Experience engaging with clients, consultants, and specifiers in a presales or solution-advisory capacity for critical infrastructure projects.
* Familiarity with data center standards and design criteria: ASHRAE, TIA-942, IEC 61850, EN 54, NFPA 72, IS 3043, NBC 2016.
* Exposure to high-density cooling architectures (DLC, liquid cooling, CDUs) and AI data center workloads is highly advantageous.

**4.3 Technical Skills Matrix**
**Skill Area**
**Proficiency Required**
**IBMS Subsystems**
Deep understanding of BMS, FACP, VESDA, WLD, Rodent Control, CCTV, Access Control, MDBs, and EPMS in critical data center facilities.
  
  
**Controller Platforms**
Proficiency in controller loading calculations, I/O mapping, and scan-time calculations for DDC/PLC systems.
  
  
**BOQ & Cost Estimation**
Ability to prepare detailed, accurate IBMS BOQs and cost estimation sheets including hardware, software, licensing, integration, and engineering effort.
  
  
**Network & Integration Architecture**
Proficiency in IBMS network topology design, protocol selection (BACnet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, OPC-UA), switch sizing, and third-party integration mapping (DCIM, SCADA, EPMS).
  
  
**Technical Proposal Writing**
Ability to produce clear, structured technical narratives, compliance matrices, scope-of-work documents, and value engineering proposals for complex bids.
  
  
**Standards & Codes**
Working knowledge of IEC 61850, EN 54, NFPA 72, ASHRAE, TIA-942, BS EN 62305, IS 3043, NBC 2016, and Vertiv internal standards (G-FI-PL-006).
  
  
**Thermal Management**
Knowledge of data center thermal management: CRAH/CRAC, chilled water plant, CDU/liquid cooling (DLC), and environmental monitoring in high-density environments.
  
  
**Software Tools**
MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Visio, Project), AutoCAD, estimation/CPQ tools, and documentation management platforms.
  
  
**SCADA / HMI / DCIM**
Familiarity with SCADA/HMI platforms for IBMS visualization, alarm management, and DCIM integration for data center monitoring.
  
  
**4.4 Soft Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent written and verbal communication in English; ability to present complex IBMS architecture concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Commercial acumen: ability to balance technical quality with cost competitiveness and understand bid strategy and margin implications.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills; able to decompose complex client requirements into definable, priceable scope elements.
* High attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy across large, multi-subsystem BOQs and complex technical proposals.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent bids under time pressure without compromising quality or accuracy.
* Collaborative team player with the confidence to challenge technical and commercial assumptions respectfully and constructively.
* Self-motivated with a quality-first mindset; proactive in identifying risks and gaps during the bid cycle.

5. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

* Experience working with the Vertiv InfraSol platform or similar critical infrastructure integrated solutions in a presales or solution architecture capacity.
* Familiarity with AI data center workloads — high-density liquid cooling (DLC/immersion), power distribution architecture, and intelligent environmental monitoring.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification, demonstrating structured approach to managing bid timelines and multi-stakeholder reviews.
* Knowledge of ISA/IEC instrumentation standards and engineering flowchart conventions for controls systems architecture.
* Experience preparing parametric estimation models and CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) frameworks for repeatable IBMS bid packages.
* Demonstrated experience with multi-hyperscale or multi-colocation client environments — understanding of client template specifications and standard scope requirements.
* Familiarity with sustainability-driven IBMS features: energy monitoring, power analytics, PUE optimization, and ESG reporting integration for data centers.

6. PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS
  
  

* Primarily office-based role with occasional site visits required for pre-bid surveys, client technical meetings, and solution demonstration events.
* Comfortable working in active data center environments during pre-bid site surveys: raised floors, live electrical equipment, and operational cooling infrastructure.
* Ability to work extended hours during peak bid periods, proposal submission deadlines, and multi-bid parallel cycles.
* Travel required: approximately 10–25% of working time, primarily domestic within India, with occasional international travel for major client engagements or vendor partner events.

* Experience using CRM or workflow tools such as Salesforce, Asana, SharePoint, or similar platforms to track opportunities, assignments, approvals, and deliverables.

* tracking support.

* Professional services, consulting, accounting, advisory, insurance, benefits, or technology industry experience is a plus.

title: Solution Manager - Architect
description:

* Deliver standard through complex implementation activities ensuring quality and reliability of the implementations.

* Act as central point of contact for customers and/ or Mastercard customer representatives throughout processing implementation project end-to-end execution.

Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don't apply for jobs unless they're 100% "qualified". If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think. We look forward to receiving your application.
  
From: "Why Women Don't Apply for Jobs Unless They're 100% Qualified" by Tara Sophia Mohr, August 2014"

description:

* Should have handled export-related businesses.

* Collaborate with Supply Chain and Operations to identify cost-reduction opportunities through optimized sourcing and subcontracting.

**3**
. Investment & Capital Expenditure (CapEx) Evaluation

* Conduct financial appraisals for investment decisions, including new machinery, tooling, and facility expansions.
* Calculate ROI, Payback Period, and Net Present Value (NPV) for proposed projects to guide management approvals.
* Track post-investment performance to ensure projected cost savings or capacities are realized.

4. Advanced Cost Accounting (Activity-Based Costing)

* Design and maintain Activity-Based Costing (ABC) models to accurately allocate overheads across diverse product lines.
* Analyze cost drivers to eliminate non-value-added expenses and improve product-level profitability.

Perform regular variance analyses (Standard vs. Actual costs) and implement corrective actions.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Professional Qualification: ICWA / CMA
* Experience: 5–6 years of core industrial costing experience, with a strong preference for the automotive domain (Tier-1 or OEM).
* Technical Costing: Strong command over Activity-Based Costing (ABC), standard costing, and marginal costing principles.
* Tools: Proficiency in ERP systems (Oracle, or similar) and advanced MS Excel (financial modelling, macros).

**Key Competencies:**

* Deep understanding of manufacturing processes (e.g., machining, stamping, casting, assembly) and their associated cost structures.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills to work alongside Engineering, Procurement, and Sales teams.
* Sharp analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

Reporting would be to Director - Finance

title: Cafe Partnerships Associate, Food and Beverage
description:
I am looking for a serial cafe hopper in Pune.

I run Blendonomics. We supply coffee beans, hot chocolate and beverage products to cafes across India. Pune is already one of our important markets, and I am spending time here to grow it: more cafes on board, and a strong distributor network across the city.

I need one person on the ground who loves cafes as much as I do.

This is not a target-pushing sales job. You will be the person Pune cafes know from Blendonomics. You visit cafes, run tastings, listen to owners and baristas, and help them decide if our products fit their menu. What you hear in the field comes straight to me and our head office team, and it shapes what we do next.

What you will do

• Visit cafes across Pune that have asked to try our products, and find new ones on your own beat.

• Run tastings and explain the product in clear, honest terms.

• Find out what works on a cafe's menu, what worries the owner, and what they need.

• Log every visit the same day and send a short field report every week.

• Follow up with cafes so they keep ordering because the product works for them.

• Work with me, our head office team and our distribution partners in Pune.

You must have

• Some experience in or with cafes, restaurants, hotels, catering, food delivery or food brands. Any role counts: barista, floor staff, kitchen, outlet operations, restaurant onboarding, food sales, food content, internships or part-time work.

• Good spoken and written English. Marathi and Hindi too.

• A two-wheeler and a valid licence, and you are happy to be on the road most days.

• You live in Pune.

• You are available full-time. This role does not suit students in regular day college.

What you get

• A core-team role. You work directly with me.

• Fixed pay based on your experience, fuel support, and earnings on every order from cafes you bring in.

• A trial period to start. If it works, a full-time role with a clear path to lead the Pune market.

• Hands-on training in the cafe business, our products and B2B sales.

How to apply

Apply on LinkedIn with your resume and answer the screening questions. My team calls shortlisted candidates first, then we meet for an interview.
