title: Network Practice Leader - Architecture and Transformation
description:
Own the end-to-end architecture and solution design for enterprise network programs spanning campus/LAN, WAN, data center, cloud, and security-edge (SASE) domains.
  
  

* Produce High-Level Designs (HLD), Low-Level Designs (LLD), reference architectures, and design standards, including topology diagrams, IP/routing schemes, migration plans, and bill of materials.
* Lead technology evaluations, PoCs, and OEM/vendor selection, comparing solutions against functional, commercial, operational, and security criteria.
* Support pre-sales and solutioning activities — respond to RFPs/RFIs, size and cost solutions, present designs to customers and executives, and defend design decisions in technical reviews.
* Define transformation and migration strategies for legacy-to-software-defined transitions (e.g., traditional WAN → SD-WAN/SASE, classic DC → spine-leaf fabric, campus → SD-Access/fabric).
* Embed security-by-design — micro-segmentation, Zero Trust, secure edge, and integration with the broader security architecture.
* Drive network automation and Infrastructure-as-Code adoption across designs (templating, ZTP, CI/CD for network config).
* Establish design governance — architecture review boards, design patterns, guardrails, and documentation standards.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to network engineers and junior architects; act as design escalation point during delivery.
* Partner with cloud, security, applications, and infrastructure teams to ensure the network architecture aligns with the wider enterprise architecture and roadmaps.

title: Client Manager - IATF
description:
We exist to create positive change for people and the planet. Join us and make a difference too!
  
  
**Purpose of the position**

* To conduct on-site assessments against the requirements of relevant standards or specifications
* To provide expertise, produce surveillance and initial assessment reports and make recommendations for certification decisions.
* To promote the BSI product offering and solutions to our clients with the view of improving their business performance, managing risk and “Making excellence a habit”

**Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities**

* Undertake management system assessments in accordance with BSI requirements.
* Prepare assessment reports and deliver findings to clients to ensure client understanding of the assessment decision and clear direction to particular items of corrective action where appropriate.
* Recommend the issue, re-issue or withdrawal of certificates, and report recommendations in accordance with BSI policy, procedures and prescribed time frame.
* Lead assessment teams as required ensuring that team members are adequately briefed so that quality of service is maintained and that effective working relationships are sustained both with Clients and within the team
* Establish and develop an effective partnership with clients by delivering effective audits increasing client satisfaction with clients in your portfolio.
* Provide accurate and prompt information to support services, working closely with them to ensure that client records are up to date and complete and that all other internal information requirements are met.
* Plan/schedule workloads to make best use of own time and maximize revenue-earning activity. Coach colleagues as appropriate especially where those members are inexperienced assessors or unfamiliar with clients' business/technology and assist in the induction and coaching of new colleagues as requested.
* Maintain and develop assessment skills and technical and management system standards knowledge.
* Provide technical support to sales and customer service staff.
* Participate in witness audits and calibration sessions.
* Adhere strictly to IATF rules, accreditation requirements, and BSI internal procedures.
* Ensure audit impartiality, confidentiality, and professional conduct.
* Support complaint handling, appeals, and technical reviews when required.
* Support planning teams with audit scheduling inputs and availability
* Act as a brand Ambassador for BSI. This means acting ethically, following company rules and promoting BSI services to clients so they are able to optimize business performance and “Make Excellence a Habit”.

**Candidate specifications**

* Bachelor’s degree/Diploma or above in Engineering field.
* Qualified IATF 16949 Auditor with ADP.
* Demonstrate sector-specific knowledge (e.g., manufacturing processes, core tools like APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, MSA)
* Exposure to multiple automotive manufacturing processes (e.g., machining, assembly, injection molding, etc.)
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of IATF rules and Customer Specific requirements.
* Minimum 4–6 years of experience in conducting IATF audits.
* Knowledge of business processes and application of quality management standards
* Good verbal and written communication skills and an eye for detail
* Be self-motivated, flexible, and have excellent time management/planning skills
* Can work under pressure
* Willing to travel on business intensively
* An enthusiastic and committed team player
* Good public speaking and business development skill will be considered advantageous

**Key performance indicators**

* Delivery of man-days as booked in time and good quality work together with positive feedback from clients
* Feedback efficiently to both clients and internal queries Timely submission of reports
* Actively solve problems when needed with “can do” attitude
* Add value to clients by identifying their needs and introducing multiple BSI services to improve clients business performance and help them “Make excellence a habit”
* Help to avoid customer attrition by providing quality value added service and technical support

**Travel Requirements**

* Regular travel required for on-site assessments.

**Language Requirements**

* Proficiency in Business English (written and spoken).

**About Us**
BSI is a business improvement and standards company and for over a century BSI has been recognized for having a positive impact on organizations and society, building trust and enhancing lives.
  
  
Today BSI partners with more than 77,500 clients in 195 countries and engages with a 15,000 strong global community of experts, industry and consumer groups, organizations and governments.
  
  
Utilizing its extensive expertise in key industry sectors - including automotive, aerospace, built environment, food and retail, and healthcare - BSI delivers on its purpose by helping its clients fulfil theirs.
  
  
Living by our core values of Client-Centricity, Agility, and Collaboration, BSI provides organizations with the confidence to grow by partnering with them to tackle society’s critical issues – from climate change to building trust in digital transformation and everything in between - to accelerate progress towards a better society and a sustainable world.
  
  
BSI is an Equal Opportunity Employer dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

.

**Technical Deployment & Engineering**

**Customer Implementation & Consulting**

* Conduct technical discovery workshops to understand customer environments, security architecture, business requirements, and deployment objectives.
* Translate customer requirements into implementation strategies and deployment plans.
* Guide enterprise customers through implementation milestones, production readiness, and operational best practices.
* Deliver implementation documentation, technical knowledge transfer, and deployment recommendations.
* Build trusted relationships with customer Security, Infrastructure, Cloud, and IT Operations teams.
* Partner with Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Product Management, and Engineering to ensure successful customer adoption.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience implementing enterprise cloud-based SaaS solutions.
* Proven experience leading enterprise customer implementations from technical discovery through production deployment.
* Strong customer-facing experience working with enterprise IT and Security organizations.
* Hands-on experience integrating enterprise platforms using REST APIs.
* Experience using scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar to automate deployments, integrations, operational workflows, or troubleshooting tasks.
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to independently lead multiple enterprise implementation engagements.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Experience**
Candidates with implementation experience in one or more of the following solution domains are highly preferred:
  
  

* Vulnerability & Exposure Management
* Patch Management
* Policy Compliance
* Endpoint Security / EDR
* Cloud Security (CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP)
* Container Security
* Web Application Security
* External Attack Surface Management
* Asset Management
* Identity & Access Management
* Security Information & Event Management (SIEM)

**Technical Skills**
**Candidates are not expected to possess expertise in every technology listed below. Successful candidates should demonstrate strong competency across multiple areas depending on their background and implementation experience.**
Experience in several of the following areas is preferred:
  
  

* Windows and Linux administration
* Enterprise networking (TCP/IP, DNS, Routing, Firewalls, VPNs, Proxy Servers, Load Balancers)
* Public cloud platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform)
* Identity and authentication technologies (Active Directory, LDAP, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect)

* Scripting and automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages
* Virtualization and container technologies (VMware, Docker, Kubernetes)

**Preferred Industry Background**
Experience implementing enterprise cybersecurity or cloud-native SaaS solutions within customer environments is highly preferred. Candidates from organizations specializing in vulnerability management, cloud security, endpoint security, exposure management, identity security, or enterprise security platforms will be well suited for this role.

title: Implementation Consultant
description:
What You'll Do
  
  

* Serve as a senior technical authority and trusted advisor leading end-to-end technical implementations, complex solution architectures, and multi-system integrations for mid-market and enterprise customers adopting Avalara's cloud compliance platform.
* Translate intricate customer business models, global tax compliance requirements, and high-volume transactional workflows into robust, scalable, and resilient technical configurations.
* Champion an AI-first approach to accelerate customer onboarding, reduce project cycle times, and optimize time-to-first-transaction.
* Partner cross-functionally with customer IT, finance leadership, developers, and Avalara internal teams to navigate complex integration landscapes and mitigate cutover risks.
* Elevate organizational delivery excellence by setting technical benchmarks, mentoring team members, and establishing reusable technical assets and automation frameworks.

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**

* Lead advanced solution architecture, custom integration workflows, and tax rule mappings across enterprise applications including ERP, CRM, eCommerce, and Billing systems.
* Evaluate multifaceted business processes, multi-jurisdiction nexus footprints, cross-border taxability rules, and enterprise data schemas to design secure and scalable integrations.
* Design and execute comprehensive end-to-end testing strategies, validate complex API payloads, reconcile high-volume transaction calculations, and resolve nuanced configuration discrepancies prior to production cutover.
* Serve as the technical escalation lead for high-complexity integration challenges, troubleshooting root causes and partnering with Engineering and Product to resolve blockers and influence roadmap improvements.
* Conduct technical discovery sessions, executive-level architecture reviews, and deliver structured administrator and technical training to empower client teams.
* Coach and mentor junior consultants on integration best practices, troubleshooting methodologies, and customer management while conducting peer configuration reviews.
* Pioneer and champion AI-driven tools, reusable integration templates, diagnostic scripts, and automated test workflows to drive operational scale across the global consulting practice.
* Take full ownership of implementation project milestones, ensuring high-quality go-lives with robust test coverage and zero critical post-launch defects.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, BCA, MCA, or related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* Experience: 5–8 years of hands-on experience in technical implementation, systems integration, or technical consulting within B2B SaaS or enterprise software environments.
* Enterprise Systems & ERP Expertise: Proven track record of configuring, integrating, and troubleshooting leading enterprise applications (e.g., NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, Salesforce, Sage Intacct, Workday, or major eCommerce platforms).
* Technical & Integration Skills: Strong expertise in APIs, JSON/XML payloads, data transformation tools, middleware/iPaaS platforms, and advanced data analysis (SQL, Excel, or scripting).
* Autonomous Project Leadership: Demonstrated ability to independently manage a portfolio of simultaneous enterprise customer implementations in a fast-paced environment.
* Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills, with proven ability to lead technical workshops and influence customer architects, developers, and executive stakeholders.
* Applied AI Fluency: Practical experience utilizing generative AI tools to accelerate technical discovery, troubleshooting, script generation, and documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Tax & Compliance Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with transaction tax principles (US Sales & Use Tax, VAT/GST, e-Invoicing) or hands-on experience with automated tax engines
* Consulting Background: Prior experience working within technology consulting firms or enterprise Professional Services organizations.
* Architecture & Scripting Tools: Familiarity with cloud architectures, scripting languages (Python, JavaScript/Node.js), and API testing suites (Postman, SoapUI).
* Delivery Methodologies: Experience with Agile/Scrum implementation methodologies, PSA tools, and collaborative project management platforms.

Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Prop Amora is a dedicated real estate consulting firm that helps individuals, families, investors, and businesses make confident property decisions with transparency and trusted guidance. The company provides end-to-end consulting across residential, commercial, and investment properties, supporting clients from opportunity identification and market evaluation to site visits, negotiations, and transaction support. Prop Amora focuses on building long-term relationships by deeply understanding each client’s goals and risk appetite. By offering tailored recommendations, the firm aims to maximize value, minimize risk, and create a reliable, insight-driven experience for every client.

As a Relationship Manager at Prop Amora, you will manage and grow client relationships across residential, commercial, and investment property segments. * Strong client relationship management skills, including the ability to understand client requirements, build trust, and provide tailored recommendations.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for presentations, negotiations, and ongoing client interaction.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of real estate markets, property types, and investment considerations, preferably in the Pune region.
* Organizational and time-management skills to handle multiple clients, site visits, documentation, and follow-ups efficiently.
* Proficiency with standard office and CRM tools for maintaining client records, tracking leads, and preparing reports.
* Ability to work on-site, conduct regular field visits, and adapt to a dynamic, target-driven environment.
* Prior experience in real estate consulting, sales, or financial services relationship management is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Management, Marketing, or a related field preferred.

title: Data Solutions Consultant
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
As a
**Data Solutions Consultant,**
you will support some of Addepar’s complex and high-touch client data implementation projects. You’ll design scalable solutions to transform and integrate clients’ portfolio data into Addepar, and build expertise across both technical and business domains.
  
  
You’ll also be among the
**first members of the Data Solutions team based in India**
, helping establish our presence in the region while working closely with colleagues across the U.S., U.K., and other global offices. This is a collaborative role offering the opportunity to shape our operating model locally and strengthen how our global teams deliver together.
  
  
Beyond client delivery, you’ll also have the opportunity to participate in internal innovation; contributing to automation, tooling, and best practices that enable scale and elevate how we operate globally. This is an individual contributor position for someone who thrives at the intersection of finance, data, and technology, and is excited to make a global impact from India.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Support complex client implementations: execute data conversion projects to extract, transform, and load historical portfolio data from clients’ legacy systems into Addepar
* Build scalable data solutions: Translate client requirements into flexible, sustainable workflows that enable accurate reporting and analysis, with guidance from senior team members
* Contribute to a portfolio of high-impact projects: Manage multiple concurrent client engagements, prioritizing effectively and driving each to successful completion
* Collaborate across teams: Building knowledge of investment-related data and partner closely with Services, Sales, Product, and Engineering to deliver tailored client outcomes
* Champion operational excellence: Identify and lead opportunities to streamline, automate, and improve our delivery processes and workflows

**Who You Are**

* Experienced: 2+ years of experience in technology, finance, or consulting, with a strong record of leading complex data or financial system integration projects
* Technical: Proficiency in Python and SQL. You should be comfortable navigating large datasets, streamlining data flows (ETL), and finding ways to automate repetitive manual tasks to improve efficiency. Experience/familiarity with Databricks and API workflows is a plus.
* Investment-Savvy:
* A foundational grasp of the investment landscape. You understand how different assets work—like stocks, bonds, and derivatives—and you’re familiar with the basics of how portfolios are tracked and accounted for.
* Experience working directly with the building blocks of investment data. You’ve handled things like security identifiers, trade records, and market pricing updates, and you understand how this information flows through a financial firm.
* Technical Translation: Ability to articulate technical architectures to non-technical internal teams, converting technical requirements into clear, actionable business value.
* Solutions-Oriented: Curious problem-solver who takes initiative and is developing ownership and accountability in ambiguous environments
* Collaborative: Eager to work across teams and functions to deliver measurable impact
* Process-Minded: Highly organized, detail-oriented, and continuously looking for ways to improve efficiency and scale
* Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and global stakeholders

**A Note On Requirements**
Don’t check every single box? Apply anyway. We are looking for curious, motivated individuals. If you are passionate about the intersection of finance and tech but don't meet every specific qualification listed above, we still want to hear from you and see if your unique skills could be a fit for our team.
  
  
**Important Note: This role will require you to work from Pune office 3 days a week in UK shift i.e. 2:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST. (hybrid role)**
**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

description:

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

**About the Position**

Energy Exemplar is the leader in energy market/system simulation software, with its two platforms: PLEXOS and AURORA. These software platforms have a significant presence in global markets. We are seeking a confident, self-motivated and professional person for the role of 
**Lead Energy Market Analyst**

* Learn our software to an advanced level.

* Assist Account Management with Retention calls and visits with clients
* Assist in preparation and presentations for energy related tradeshows and conferences
* Travel to client sites as required.

**Candidate Requirements & Qualifications**

* Minimum 8 Years of experience in power markets, power systems, power plant operations, etc.
* Will lead a team of Energy Market Analysts. 2+ years of experience with people management responsibility.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to research and learn new techniques
* Ability to articulate the business problem to be analyzed, quickly identify the critical elements of the problem, achieve a high-quality answer in a timely fashion, and synthesize answers to resonate with decision makers.
* Excellent communication skills, including strong verbal, presentation, and technical writing abilities.
* Team player, with the ability to be a self-starter and work independently as needed.
* Knowledge of fundamental energy market analysis, capacity markets, environmental markets, demand side management/energy efficiency, electric utility resource planning approaches
* Demonstrated working knowledge of SaaS products and experience troubleshooting issues with Cloud offerings.
* Demonstrated capability of effectively communicating complex ideas and analysis verbally, in document format (Word), and in presentation format (Power Point).
* Experience with computer and database management languages such as VBA, Python and SQL

* Experience with power market production cost and expansion planning models

* Bachelor’s degree: Electrical Engineering, Another Engineering Degree, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Economics, Applied Math, Physics, or related field.

**Key Stakeholder Relationships**

This role works collaboratively with all Energy Exemplar staff, particularly:

* Indian Development Centre colleagues
* Senior IDC Management
* Chief Product Officer
* Global Product Delivery Team

* Global Support Team

**Working Hours**

The support team operates across shifts including:

* 1:00 PM – 10:00 PM IST

You will initially commence on the 1pm to 10pm shift pattern. Please note that shift schedules are expected to change from January, and we are looking for candidates who are flexible and open to working across all shift patterns as required.

title: Senior AI Enablement Manager
description:
**Shape the Future of AI-Driven Performance in Tissue**
At Valmet Tissue, we believe Artificial Intelligence will become a key enabler of growth, productivity, customer value, and operational excellence. We are looking for an experienced and business-oriented AI Enablement Lead to accelerate the adoption of AI across our organization.
  
  
This role will initially focus on Commercial Excellence, Sales, Service, and Business Analytics, where immediate opportunities exist to improve productivity, forecasting, customer engagement, opportunity management, and decision-making. Over time, the role will expand to support AI-driven transformation across Engineering, Supply Chain, Project Management, Manufacturing, and Business Support functions.
  
  
This is not solely a technical development role. Instead, we are seeking a business leader who can identify opportunities, drive adoption, lead change, and ensure that AI creates measurable value across the organization. This aligns with Valmet's business-led AI strategy, emphasizing value realization, adoption, capability building, and scalable implementation.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Develop and execute the Tissue AI enablement roadmap.

* Prioritize and coordinate AI projects across functions.
* Promote scalable and reusable AI solutions across the organization.

* Improve sales productivity through AI-enabled tools and processes.
* Support opportunity management, forecasting, account planning, pricing, and proposal generation.
* Reduce manual administrative work and increase customer-facing time.
* Enhance installed-base monetization and customer insights.
* Drive data-driven decision-making across commercial teams.

Lead AI adoption & change
  
  

* Build and lead a network of AI Champions across Tissue.
* Deliver training, awareness programs, and practical AI workshops.
* Support leaders in redesigning processes and ways of working.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure successful adoption of AI capabilities throughout the organization.

Expand AI across functions
  
  
**As Adoption Matures, Support AI Initiatives In**

* Engineering and design productivity
* Supply chain planning and optimization
* Project execution
* Customer support and service operations
* Knowledge management
* Business support functions
* Performance management and analytics

Partner across the organization
  
  

* Act as the key interface between Tissue business teams and enterprise AI initiatives.
* Collaborate with IT, Digital, Data & Analytics, and process owners.
* Ensure AI solutions support business priorities and strategic objectives.
* Promote responsible and compliant use of AI technologies.

What success looks like
  
  

* Increased sales productivity and reduced administrative workload.
* Higher adoption of AI tools and capabilities.
* Improved forecast accuracy and commercial effectiveness.
* Measurable business value delivered through AI initiatives.
* Increased organizational AI capability and literacy.
* AI-enabled process improvements deployed across multiple functions.
* A growing portfolio of scalable use cases delivering sustainable business impact.

**Your profile**
You combine business acumen, transformation leadership, and a passion for technology-enabled improvement.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in Commercial Excellence, Sales Operations, Business Transformation, Continuous Improvement, Digital Transformation, or related fields.
* Experience leading cross-functional change initiatives.
* Strong understanding of commercial processes and business performance drivers.
* Exposure to AI, analytics, automation, or digital technologies.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About Maxion Wheels**
As the largest manufacturer of wheels for the global marketplace, Maxion Wheels is continually seeking motivated individuals who have what it takes to make a positive impact on our business and our customers. Our long history, and our products, internationally recognized for their quality and innovation, make us one of the most respected OEM suppliers in the automotive industry.
  
  
For our Sales & Marketing Department in Kalyani Maxion Wheels Pvt. Ltd., Chakan, Pune - India, we are looking for an
  
  
**Key Account Manager**
The Key Account Manager (KAM) to lead business development and sales initiatives in alignment with our Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and Business Plan (BP). This role is responsible for managing OEM relationships, driving revenue growth, ensuring receivables discipline, and supporting quality systems compliance.
  
  

* Drive business development and manage sales performance as per AOP/BP.
* Maintain and grow share of business with OEMs.
* Manage cost compensation related to raw materials and other variables.
* Track and analyze market trends and competitor activities.
* Ensure timely collections and adherence to Maxion’s receivables policies.
* Support departmental compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 14000, OHSAS, and other quality systems.

**Your future role**
****Business Development (AOP/BP Aligned)****

* Visit automotive OEMs (excluding 2-wheelers) to introduce Maxion Wheels.
* Track OEM development plans and ensure timely receipt of RFQs.
* Collaborate with Engineering and Finance teams to analyze RFQ requirements and prepare competitive offers.
* Engage with OEMs to understand offer competitiveness and revise proposals accordingly.
* Track competitor strategies and make course correction, if required.
* Capture and report final customer decisions (business win/loss).

****Sales Management as per AOP/BP****

* Monitor OEM forecasts and align part-wise sales with AOP/BP targets.
* Ensure volume commitments are met as per agreed share of business.
* Coordinate with internal teams (planning, operations, supply chain) for seamless execution.
* Track daily consumption at OEMs and adjust internal forecasts accordingly.
* Develop contingency plans for volume fluctuations to minimize plant impact.
* Ensure timely and adequate supply to OEMs with agreed stock levels.

****Receivables & Policy Compliance****

* Regular reconciliation of customer accounts.
* Follow up diligently on overdue and due payments.
* Monitor and manage customer-specific credit limits.
* Ensure all documentation complies with Maxion’s financial policies.

****Market & Competitor Analysis****

* Track and report OEM sales trends and market intelligence.
* Monitor share of business based on actual OEM production.
* Maintain competitor activity reports and insights.

**Quality Systems & Documentation**

* Ensure departmental compliance with IATF 16949 and other quality systems.
* Conduct and analyze customer satisfaction surveys; present findings to management.
* Collaborate with MR/Environmental Manager for documentation, audits, and improvement plans.

**Your profile**

* Bachelor of Engineering – Mechanical, MBA – Marketing is a plus
* At least 15 years of relevant experience in Automobile related products and handling reputed Auto OEM’s.
* Culturally sensitive and has the ability and interest to identify and work with a multicultural team
* Ability to work in Matrix Organization
* Conflict Management
* Advanced Excel & presentation skills
* Strong analytical and quantitative competencies
* Understands complex concepts and the relationships between issues or problems
* Effectively communicates across organization and is confident in interacting with senior leadership team
* Exposure of working with various advance sales tools.

Maxion Wheels maintains a written and widely distributed policy on equal employment opportunity. The Company recruits, hires, trains, promotes, administers policies, bases decisions and conducts all personnel activities without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability (to the extent an undue hardship is not imposed), status as a covered veteran or other legally protected status, in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.

title: Salesperson
description:
**Company Description**
Ayurcin Biogenics Pvt Ltd is an innovative healthcare company specializing in patented herbal milk products, herbal Nutri-bars, and exporting medicines through contract manufacturing. Its flagship products include Ayur-Enzo Milk, formulated with herbs such as shatavari, ashwagandha, brahmi, shilajit, arjun, and tulsi to help address malnutrition in society. The company also offers Ayubar, an herbal Nutri-bar made from natural herbs, and Ayurbeat, a fully ayurvedic anti-diabetic liquid exported to Mauritius and sold across India, with sales exceeding 70,000 bottles. Ayurcin is incubated at multiple agri and innovation centers including ISB Agri Impact, RKVY Raftaar MANAGE CIA, AIC ADT Baramati Agricultural College, NAFARI, and is a member of ASSOCHAM, reflecting strong industry connections and growth potential for team members.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Salesperson role based in Pune City. The Salesperson will be responsible for identifying and engaging potential distributors and retailers, presenting product benefits, and demonstrating how Ayurcin’s herbal products can address customer needs. Daily activities include visiting prospects and existing clients, conducting product pitches, following up on leads, closing sales, and meeting assigned sales targets. The role involves coordinating with internal teams on pricing, supply, and delivery, maintaining accurate sales records, and providing feedback from the market to support product and strategy improvements. The Salesperson will also participate in local promotional activities, build long-term relationships with partners, and represent the brand professionally in the field.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong sales and negotiation skills, with the ability to convert leads into long-term business relationships.
* Experience in field sales, FMCG, pharmaceutical, or nutraceutical products, preferably within the Pune region or surrounding markets.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain product features and health benefits in a clear, confident manner.
* Basic understanding of herbal, ayurvedic, or nutritional products and willingness to learn product details in depth.
* Ability to work independently in the field, manage time effectively, and consistently achieve or exceed sales targets.
* Comfort with maintaining records, using mobile or computer-based tools for reporting, and sharing regular updates with the sales team.
* Minimum educational background of a high school diploma; a bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, life sciences, or related fields is an advantage.
* Prior experience in distribution network development or channel sales is highly beneficial.

title: Senior Demo Platform Architect
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Demo Platform Architect – Contact Center and Customer Experience**
**Position Overview:**
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Demo Platform Engineer with deep expertise in contact center technologies and CX suites, preferably Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS. This role will own the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of shared demo environments and reusable customer service use cases. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on technical expertise, strong operational ownership, and independent decision-making to ensure demo environments remain reliable, current, scalable, and ready to support both internal teams and occasional customer-facing engagements.
  
  
**Core Daily Activities**

* Own and Optimize Demo Environments – Maintain reliable, scalable, secure, and high-quality shared demo environments leveraging Amazon Connect, AWS, and Zendesk.
* Develop New Demo Use Cases – Design and build compelling, reusable demonstrations that showcase contact center, customer experience, AI, automation, analytics, and integration capabilities.
* Support Custom Demo Requests – Partner with presales specialists and architects to develop opportunity-specific configurations, integrations, workflows, and demonstrations.
* Maintain Product and Release Readiness – Track Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and related technology releases and incorporate relevant capabilities into the demo portfolio.
* Drive Automation and Standardization – Develop reusable components, templates, deployment processes, and automation to improve the speed and consistency of demo delivery.
* Ensure Security, Governance, and Best Practices – Maintain appropriate access controls, data standards, platform governance, cost management, and technical quality across demo environments.
* Support Customer-Facing Activities – Occasionally participate in customer demonstrations, proof of concepts (PoCs), technical discussions, and presentations for prospects and clients.
* Develop Technical Documentation and Demo Collateral – Create technical guides, setup instructions, troubleshooting documentation, architecture diagrams, demo scripts, and internal enablement materials.
* Engage with Vendors and Partners – Work closely with AWS, Zendesk, and other partners to remain aligned with product capabilities, best practices, and technology advancements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Demo Platform Ownership: Define and execute the technical vision for shared demo environments, proactively identifying improvements, resolving issues, and ensuring environments remain available and ready for use.
* Demo Design and Development: Build compelling end-to-end contact center demonstrations leveraging Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS services to showcase customer experience, agent productivity, AI, automation, and operational performance.
* Integration Management: Design and maintain integrations between Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and other enterprise systems to support realistic workflows, consistent data, and reusable demo scenarios.
* Custom Demo Support: Work with presales specialists and architects to understand opportunity requirements and deliver tailored demonstrations while identifying opportunities to create reusable assets for the wider team.
* Technical Oversight: Establish and maintain high standards for demo architecture, configuration, testing, security, documentation, reliability, and overall presentation quality.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with internal teams, business leaders, product specialists, engineering teams, customers, and external partners to gather requirements, propose solutions, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver effective demonstrations.
* Innovation and Best Practices: Stay ahead of product releases, industry trends, and emerging technologies in contact center platforms, AI, and automation, applying them to continuously improve the demo portfolio.
* Independent Execution: Establish priorities, manage multiple concurrent requests, make informed decisions, and deliver outcomes without requiring detailed day-to-day direction.
* Governance: Establish and enforce governance frameworks for security, access control, data management, cost optimization, platform reliability, and lifecycle management of demo environments.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or Business Administration - or equivalent experience.
* Experience: Minimum of 8–10 years in solution engineering, platform engineering, solution architecture, software development, or a related technical field, with at least 5 years of experience in contact center technologies, including Amazon Connect and CRM/CX technologies, preferably Zendesk.
* Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in designing, implementing, and supporting scalable solutions using a CRM/CX platform, Amazon Connect, AWS Lambda, Amazon AI Agents (Bedrock), Amazon Lex, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and other AWS services. We will rank you higher if you have experience or exposure to Python and/or NodeJS.
* Demo Development: Demonstrated experience creating technical demonstrations, reusable use cases, prototypes, proof of concepts, or reference implementations that translate technical capabilities into compelling business scenarios.
* Platform Management: Experience maintaining shared technical environments, managing releases and configuration changes, troubleshooting complex issues, and proactively improving platform availability and reliability.
* Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to operate with ownership, take initiative, work independently, influence cross-functional teams, and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced and globally distributed environment.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to document technical solutions, collaborate across time zones, and articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of investigating root causes, making sound decisions with incomplete information, and developing scalable solutions to complex challenges.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: Zendesk certifications, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent credentials in contact center platforms.
* Industry Knowledge: Experience designing and demonstrating omnichannel contact center solutions, including voice, chat, messaging, AI-driven automation, agent assistance, Workforce Engagement Management, including workforce and quality management, and contact center reporting and analytics tools.
* Customer Engagement: Experience delivering technical demonstrations, supporting customer discussions, and responding to detailed technical questions during customer or prospect engagements.
* Agile Methodologies: Experience working within Agile and DevOps frameworks, including source control, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and repeatable deployment practices.

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.
  
  
**The Intelligent Heart Of Customer Experience**

title: Technology Consulting Manager - AI Engineering
description:
**ZS**
is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by
**bringing together data, science, technology**
and
**human ingenuity**
to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a
**client-first mentality**
to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.
  
  
The Scaled AI practice at ZS operates at the dynamic intersection of artificial intelligence and cutting-edge technology, dedicated to assisting global clients in developing, operationalizing, and scaling both Classical and Generative AI capabilities. Our team partners with leading organizations across diverse sectors—including pharma (commercial, R&D, and supply chain), travel, retail, and more—to build robust AI applications and platforms that deliver measurable business value.
  
  
As an important growth engine for ZS, Scaled AI has seen rapid expansion, marked by significant increases in both revenue and team size in recent years. This growth reflects the rising demand for enterprise-grade AI solutions and highlights our commitment to driving innovation at scale.
  
  
**Why Join the Scaled AI Team at ZS?**

* Cutting-Edge Work: Contribute to building and scaling advanced Agentic AI systems using the latest frameworks and technologies. Collaborate with AI and technology innovation labs to translate groundbreaking research into practical solutions for clients.
* Enterprise Impact: Deliver AI-driven transformation at scale for some of the world’s most prominent companies, shaping the future of industries with your expertise.
* Empowered to Innovate: Experience the autonomy to explore new ideas, drive innovation, and influence the direction of AI-enabled business transformation.
* Grow with Exceptional Talent: Work alongside outstanding engineers, data scientists, and AI leaders in a supportive, high-performance culture that values collaboration, learning, and excellence.

**Our Culture and Partnership Model**
At ZS, we foster a culture that emphasizes growth, collaboration, and the recognition of talent. Our partnership model is designed to reward exceptional contributions, ensuring that great talent is empowered and celebrated. We believe in nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment where every team member has the opportunity to learn, lead, and make a tangible impact—both within our organization and for our clients worldwide. If you are passionate about AI and ready to lead technical teams in delivering transformative AI solutions, consider joining the Scaled AI team at ZS!
  
  
**What You’ll Do :**

* Lead multiple AI and digital transformation engagements, driving successful delivery from strategy through implementation and scaled adoption.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology stakeholders, provide thought leadership in Scaling and operationalizing AI
* Build and manage client relationships across accounts while identifying opportunities to expand ZS's AI capabilities within existing and new engagements.
* Lead cross-functional teams in designing, building, and scaling enterprise AI applications powered by Generative AI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, and advanced analytics
* Contribute to Thought leadership by creating POV on industry trends in AI and technology
* Lead hiring initiatives in growing Scaled AI team and mentor technical talent within the team
* Ensure high-quality solution delivery through strong engineering, architecture, and SDLC practices.
* Drive ZS Scaling AI initiatives in tandem with global partners
* Manage budgets, resources, and vendor relationships related to AI tools and platforms
* Stay at the forefront of emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and industry trends.
* Work with ZS technology teams to take cutting edge technology implementations and ideas and bring it to the market through focused go-to-market activities

**What You’ll Bring :**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related quantitative discipline.
* 10-12+ years of experience leading technology, AI, analytics, or digital transformation initiatives within consulting, technology services, or industry environments.
* Proven experience leading client-facing engagements and managing senior stakeholder relationships.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, NLP, Knowledge Retrieval, and modern AI architecture patterns.
* Experience building, deploying, and scaling enterprise AI applications from concept through production.
* Strong knowledge of AI application development, software engineering, cloud architecture, and platform engineering practices.
* Hands-on experience with modern AI and data platforms, including Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Databricks, Dataiku, Snowflake, Vertex AI, or similar ecosystems.
* Experience operationalizing AI through MLOps, LLMOps, model governance, monitoring, evaluation, and lifecycle management.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including APIs, microservices, cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, and data engineering.
* Experience delivering solutions on public cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Agile project planning and project management experience
* Team management and skill development experience
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Highly motivated, good work ethic and enterprise maturity
* Life science domain knowledge is a plus

**How you’ll grow:**

* Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

**Perks & Benefits:**
At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations | Where we work | ZS.
  
  
**Hybrid working model:**
We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.
  
  
**Travel:**
Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.
  
  
**Considering applying?**
At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

title: Solution Engineer - Quality, Laboratory & OT Systems
description:
**Description**
At Envalior, we combine over a century of materials expertise with innovation and digital technology to help create sustainable, high-performance solutions for our customers around the world. As our laboratories, manufacturing sites, and quality organizations become increasingly digital, we are looking for a Solution Engineer who can help bridge business processes and technology across Quality, Research & Technology (R&T), and Operational Technology (OT) domains.
  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to become a key technology partner for our global laboratory and quality functions, helping ensure that critical systems are reliable, compliant, efficient, and aligned with Envalior's business ambitions.
  
  
**The Role**
As a
**Solution Engineer – Quality, Laboratory & OT Systems**
, you will act as the subject matter expert and trusted advisor for a portfolio of laboratory, quality, and manufacturing applications, with a primary focus on
**Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS)**
.
  
  
LIMS applications sit at the heart of Envalior's quality and laboratory operations. They support the management of laboratory samples, testing workflows, quality data, product specifications, and batch release activities across manufacturing and R&D environments. As the system owner and technical lead, you will ensure these platforms continue to deliver business value while supporting operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  
  
You will work closely with Quality, R&T, Operations, Manufacturing, Digital Solutions Delivery, and Technology Services teams worldwide to support existing solutions while identifying opportunities for innovation, automation, and simplification.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Own and Support Critical Laboratory & Quality Systems**

* Serve as the IT System Owner for Envalior's LIMS QA solutions.
* Manage the lifecycle of laboratory and quality applications, including enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and support activities.
* Ensure platforms remain secure, stable, and aligned with evolving business requirements.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex application and process issues.
* Support business continuity across laboratory and quality operations globally.

**Partner with the Business**

* Develop a deep understanding of Quality, R&T, and Operational Technology processes.
* Collaborate with laboratory managers, quality teams, manufacturing stakeholders, and digital colleagues to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Translate business challenges into scalable digital solutions.
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders and effectively communicate the value of technology-enabled change.

**Drive Innovation and Digital Transformation**

* Propose innovative information solutions by combining existing systems with emerging digital technologies.
* Evaluate opportunities to improve laboratory efficiency, data management, automation, and operational performance.
* Simplify and modernize existing application landscapes.
* Eliminate waste, reduce complexity, and improve user experience through technology and process optimization.

**Enable Reliable Laboratory Operations**

* Support systems used for sample management, laboratory workflows, testing activities, and quality data management.
* Ensure effective system integrations between laboratory, manufacturing, and enterprise platforms.
* Help maintain accurate, timely, and accessible laboratory information across the value chain.
* Support the digital backbone that enables quality decision-making and product release activities.

**Lead Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to strengthen system performance and business processes.
* Promote best practices in application management, information architecture, and digital solutions.
* Support change management initiatives and user adoption activities.
* Drive a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement across supported domains.

**Requirements**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* Experience in application management, solution engineering, business analysis, or related digital roles.
* Experience supporting Quality, Manufacturing, Laboratory, R&T, or Operational Technology environments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience working within global and cross-functional organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to lead change and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Technical Expertise -**
**Laboratory & Quality Systems**

* ZhuoMES
* GUSLAB / LABSQ
* Unilab
* Thermo Fisher SampleManager LIMS
* WinLIMS

**OT & Manufacturing Solutions**

* Eschbach Shiftconnector
* AssetWise

**Sustainability & Quality Platforms**

* Credit360
* Other Quality, OT, and R&T SaaS applications

**Additional Capabilities**

* Information architecture (data, process, and application landscape)
* Application lifecycle management
* Systems integration and interfacing
* Change management
* Technical project delivery
* Analytical problem solving
* Operations, Quality, and R&T process knowledge

**What Success Looks Like**
In this role, you will become the trusted digital partner for Envalior's Quality and Laboratory community. You will ensure our LIMS landscape delivers reliable support to laboratories worldwide while helping the business embrace new technologies and more efficient ways of working.
  
  
**You Will Be Successful If You Can**

* Balance technology expertise with business understanding.
* Influence stakeholders through collaboration and credibility.
* Simplify complex challenges into practical solutions.
* Drive operational efficiency through digital innovation.
* Continuously improve the applications and processes that support Envalior's quality and laboratory operations.

**Benefits**
**Competitive Compensation**
Join us at Envalior and enjoy competitive compensation packages, inclusive of a global bonus program and individual performance bonuses, ensuring your hard work is recognized and rewarded.
  
  
**Comprehensive Benefits**
Your well-being matters to us. At Envalior, we provide an array of benefits supporting your financial security, health, and overall well-being. This includes retirement plans, health programs, life insurance, and comprehensive medical care.
  
  
**Work-Life Balance & Flexibility**
Maintain a healthy balance between work and personal life with Envalior's commitment to supporting your schedule.
  
  
**Training & Development Opportunities**
At Envalior, your growth matters. We encourage and invest in your professional and personal development. We support our employees in their growth and personal development through ongoing investment in their knowledge and skills via training, coaching, and mentoring.
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
At Envalior, our people drive our success, so it’s only right that we provide a diverse and inclusive working environment and foster a culture of belonging, openness, and respect. We value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We are committed to nurturing and empowering every individual to reach their full potential.
  
  
**APPLY NOW!**
Ready to pioneer change with Envalior? Join us in our mission to drive innovation, sustainability, and excellence. Apply today and become a part of our transformative journey towards a more sustainable future.
  
  
Submit your application online by sending your CV and motivation letter in English through our career portal. If you have any questions, feel free to connect directly with our recruiter at Deepanshu.Tripathi@envalior.com
  
  
*Envalior is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.*
If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at Talent.Acquisition@Envalior.com.
  
  
**OUR HERITAGE**
With a combined heritage of over 100 years, Envalior brings together two established global materials players: DSM Engineering Materials and LANXESS High Performance Materials. Our unique combined portfolio of longstanding material-, application-, and design expertise enables our customers to develop and launch sustainable future-proof designs. Envalior is the brand new materials powerhouse that was Launched in early 2023.
  
  
We aim to be a global leader in sustainable and high-performance engineering materials. We imagine the future by shaping the world of today and tomorrow. We’re conscious that this is both a privilege and a responsibility – so, when we imagine the future, we’re guided by our key values to help us create a better world.

title: Sr Strategic Sourcing Spec
description:
**Job Description**
As a Sr Strategic Sourcing Specialist, you will be responsible for developing and executing strategic sourcing initiatives for Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) in India and EMEA or Maintenance, Repair and Operations (MRO) categories supporting Honeywell manufacturing operations in India and partially APAC.
  
  
You will partner with Engineering, Operations, Maintenance, Integrated Supply Chain, Finance, and Project Management teams to deliver productivity, improve supplier performance, mitigate commercial and supply risks, and support the successful execution of capital investment and operational reliability initiatives.
  
  
You will apply your manufacturing and strategic sourcing experience to manage complex supplier engagements, lead competitive sourcing events, negotiate commercial agreements, and implement category strategies that deliver measurable business value.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute sourcing strategies for CAPEX / MRO categories supporting manufacturing operations
* Support the execution of capital investment projects in India and EMEA region, including manufacturing expansion, capacity growth, automation, modernization, and equipment replacement initiatives
* Lead sourcing activities related to manufacturing expansion projects in Pune and Hyderabad
* Manage end-to-end sourcing activities, including requirements review, market analysis, supplier identification, RFx execution, bid evaluation, negotiation, supplier recommendation, contracting, and implementation
* Lead sourcing activities for capital equipment, production machinery, automation systems, manufacturing technologies, installation services, commissioning support, and related technical services
* Develop and implement sourcing strategies for MRO categories, including industrial spare parts, repair and maintenance services, OEM components, industrial consumables, technical services, tools, and reliability-related requirements
* Partner with Engineering and Project Management teams to align sourcing plans with technical specifications, project schedules, budgets, and implementation requirements
* Collaborate with Operations and Maintenance teams to support equipment availability, operational continuity, and manufacturing reliability
* Drive productivity through competitive bidding, supplier negotiations, demand management, value engineering, specification optimization, supplier consolidation, and total cost of ownership analysis
* Conduct supply market analysis and supplier benchmarking to support sourcing decisions
* Monitor supplier performance across quality, delivery, cost, service, responsiveness, and compliance
* Lead supplier performance reviews and establish corrective action and continuous improvement plans as needed
* Evaluate supplier capabilities, capacity, financial health, commercial position, and supply continuity risks
* Develop and execute mitigation plans for supplier, contractual, commercial, and project-execution risks
* Lead commercial negotiations involving pricing, payment terms, productivity commitments, warranties, service levels, liability, and other contractual requirements
* Ensure compliance with Honeywell sourcing policies, ethical requirements, approval processes, and contract governance standards
* Support contract development, execution, administration, supplier compliance, and resolution of commercial issues
* Maintain and support accurate sourcing plans, project updates, savings forecasts, supplier information, risk documentation, supporting records, annual productivity, working capital, cost optimization, and supply continuity objectives
* Influence cross-functional stakeholders and gain alignment on sourcing recommendations, supplier selection, and commercial decisions
* Promote standard sourcing processes, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement across the India CAPEX and MRO portfolio

CAPEX strategy includes categories such as processing machinery, test & analytical, automation and process controls, HVAC (Heating, Ventilation & Air Conditioning), material handling, packaging and other industrial equipment, supplies & services Meanwhile, MRO strategy includes categories such as OEM spare parts, pumps, pipes, valves and fittings, motors, bearings, power transmission, pneumatics, hydraulics, hardware, fasteners, industrial gases, chemicals, lubricants, cutting tools, hand and power tools, electrical supplies, and other industrial materials.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**YOU MUST HAVE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Finance, or a related discipline
* 7 to 10 years of experience in Strategic Sourcing, Procurement, Supply Chain, Category Management, or a related field
* Demonstrated experience working in or directly supporting a manufacturing environment
* Experience developing and executing strategic sourcing initiatives for CAPEX and/or MRO categories
* Experience sourcing capital equipment, production machinery, industrial equipment, maintenance services, spare parts, technical services, and/or industrial consumables
* Experience leading competitive sourcing events, including RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, bid evaluations, supplier selection, and commercial negotiations
* Experience negotiating supplier contracts, commercial terms, payment terms, warranties, and service-level requirements
* Experience managing supplier relationships and driving supplier performance improvements
* Demonstrated ability to deliver measurable cost reduction, productivity, working capital, or total cost improvements
* Strong analytical, financial, negotiation, and commercial decision-making skills
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering, Operations, Maintenance, Finance, Integrated Supply Chain, and Project Management stakeholders
* Ability to communicate effectively in English within a global business environment

**WE VALUE**

* Engineering background combined with strategic sourcing or procurement experience
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations and industrial supply markets and possessing strong project management and organizational skills
* Strong knowledge of MRO sourcing, industrial spare parts, maintenance services, OEM requirements, industrial supplies, and reliability-related procurement
* Experience supporting greenfield, brownfield, manufacturing expansion, automation, modernization, capacity growth, or equipment replacement projects
* Experience managing sourcing activities from specification development through supplier selection, contracting, delivery, installation, commissioning support, and project closeout
* Experience applying total cost of ownership, should-cost analysis, cost modeling, value engineering, and cost-benefit analysis
* Experience using supplier scorecards, business reviews, corrective actions, and continuous improvement plans
* Knowledge of contract governance, commercial risk management, supplier compliance, and sourcing controls
* Ability to manage multiple sourcing projects and priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
* Strong problem-solving, communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills, as well as influence stakeholders and drive alignment without direct authority
* Experience working across global and regional teams in a matrixed organization
* Lean, Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, or Operational Excellence experience mind set
* Knowledge of eSourcing, spend analytics, contract management, and procurement systems.

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Presales Executive
description:
**Job Description- Pre-sales Lead**

**Overview:**
Sellability is on an aggressive, market-redefining growth trajectory, with development mandates spanning residential, commercial and mixed-use projects. We're a merit-driven, entrepreneurial team — the kind of place where ambitious, hard-working people get real ownership early, not after they've proven themselves for years.

At Sellability, you don't just build a job, you build a legacy: fast-tracked career growth, structured mentorship, exposure to marquee developers, and a direct hand in redefining how real estate is sold and marketed in India. Our projects demand year-round market activation and sustained brand salience. As we serve an AOP of INR 5000 Cr+ and growing, Marketing carries a real mandate: project branding, launch and sustenance support, and constant innovation.

**About the role:**

Every sale starts in pre-sales. As Team Lead, you'll run the team that turns enquiries into site visits. That means making sure every lead is called quickly, qualified properly and handed to the closing team ready to convert. You set the pace, coach the callers and own the numbers at the top of the funnel.

**What you will own:**

* **Team performance:**
  Lead and coach a team of pre-sales executives against daily and weekly targets for calls, connects, qualified leads and site visits.
* **Lead management:**
  Make sure every lead, whether from digital, channel partners, events or walk-ins, is contacted within the agreed response time and followed up until it closes out, with the CRM kept accurate.
* **Funnel conversion:**
  Track the funnel from lead to connect, qualified lead, visit scheduled and visit done. Spot where leads drop off and fix it.
* **Quality:**
  Build and refresh pitch scripts and objection handling for each project. Run regular call audits and give feedback.
* **Working with sales:**
  Coordinate with closing managers and site heads on visit scheduling, and feed their visit outcomes back into how the team qualifies leads.
* **Working with marketing:**
  Share lead-quality insights by source and campaign so spend goes where leads actually convert.
* **Reporting:**
  Send daily and weekly reports on team performance and funnel health to the cluster head.
* **Building the team:**
  Hire, onboard and train new pre-sales team members.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 4–6 years in real estate pre-sales or tele-sales, including at least 1–2 years leading a team.
* A strong grip on funnel metrics, and comfort working in a CRM and Excel every day.
* A coach's mindset: you make callers better, not just busier.
* Fluency in English, Hindi and Marathi.
* Knowledge of Pune's residential market is a strong plus.
* A graduate degree in any discipline.

**Location:**
Baner, Pune

**Note:**
Its a 6-day WFO role

**Why Sellability**

* **Growth without limits**
  — Real leadership scope from day one: shape the brand strategy for a portfolio scaling toward INR 5000 Cr+, with direct exposure to marquee developers and large-scale launches.
* **Performance with rewards**
  — A merit-driven culture where your strategy, your calls and your outcomes are visible at the top, not buried in a hierarchy.
* **Collaborative culture**
  — Work directly with founder-level leadership, in a transparent, "one team" environment built for people who want to build, not just execute.
* **Purpose & impact**
  — Own the brand for one of the most ambitious portfolios in the market, with the mandate to redefine how real estate is sold and marketed in India.

description:

Apna Ghar Lifespaces Pvt Ltd. collaborates with leading, reputable builders across the Pune region to help homebuyers make confident, informed decisions. * Challenge concepts, solutions and assumptions in constructive ways to truly differentiate and develop unique value propositions. End Game (Bids & Proposals)

* Champion use of Client Success Platform (CSP) for approvals & linked SharePoint for End Game document collaboration.
